race.comment: LATASSA (6) finished fourth when resuming at Bendigo two runs back then improved last start but found one better over 1600m at Pakenham Synthetic, beaten 2 lengths after being prominent at the corner. Perfectly placed and is sure to take a ton of beating. AKARI SPIRIT (1) is becoming costly, with three minor placings from three starts this campaign, finishing a long neck from the winner in second at the latest outing over 1600m at Bendigo. Looks well placed so expect another big run. ENTICEMENT (10) was at long odds on debut last time out and finished fifth, beaten 2.5 lengths, over 1500m at Ballarat but looks to have upside and worth including. WAVELETS (7) resumes at 1612m, which looks a task, but form was adequate last prep and has trialled well ahead of the return.
